player_prompt.intro:
Yu bilong Pleya {player_id} long Connect Four.
Simbol bilong disk bilong yu: {symbol}.
Bord bilong gem i gat {num_rows} row na {num_cols} kolom.
Pleya i kamap long turn long rausim disk bilong ol i go insait long wanpela kolom (0 to {end_col}).
Pleya bilong wonem i kamap na winim (disk bilong em yet) long vertikal, horizontal, o diagonal.
Long turn bilong yu, yu putim namba bilong kolom i go insait long brakets squared long mekim muv bilong yu.
Olsem sampel: '[col 4]' o '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Ol man i no inap lukim bodi bilong pilai.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Pleya {player_id}, Format bilong aksem i rong. Format bilong wonem: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Pleya {player_id}, Aksem invalid. Kolom {col} i go longwe beyon.
invalid_move.already_full: Pleya {player_id}, Aksem invalid. Kolom {col} i ful.

action.dropped_disk: Pleya {player_id} rausim disk bilong em ({player_symbol}) i go insait long kolom {col}.

outcome.win: Man {player_id} i winim sapos em i bungim 4-pela!
